text: Swimming, an activity that combines physical and mental strength, offers a great workout. To optimize performance, swimmers must pay close attention to breathing, doing it carefully at the right moment to avoid exhaustion. Moreover, swimmers should focus on their kicking pattern, ensuring it is smooth and controlled. By doing so, they can maintain efficiency and speed, enhancing their overall performance. Proper breathing technique is also crucial, as it helps conserve energy and allows swimmers to stay focused throughout the stroke.
